A three-time U.S. Open host and recognized by Travel + Leisure Golf Magazine as the Best Golf Resort in America, Pinehurst provides a breathtaking setting for your tennis journey. results.name: Nike Soccer Camp in Northbrook -  (Nov. 23ΓÇô25, 2026)
results.description: Illinois Skill School was voted a Top-10 Nike Soccer Camp in 2024 & 2025 by players and parents! Join us for Nike Soccer Camp in Northbrook with Kyle Jones, owner of Illinois Skill Schools. The camp is designed for boys and girls, of all abilities, ages 6-16, to develop and refine skills and techniques. An amazing opportunity for any player to learn from a top coaching professional, have fun, and train in a competitive setting! Illinois Skill Schools' and Soccer Skill Schools' "Numbers Approach Methodology" brings the best skill development methods from all over the world to the midwest with particular influence from Brazil, Holland, England, and Spain. The methodology starts with one player: the individual. Each player is guided toward complete mastery of the ball, encouraged to make decisions of their own, and equipped with over 60 individual skills to help win the individual competitions that take place during every game. Hear from Coach Kyle Jones: "We create an environment where players are challenged, supported, and inspired every day. Through high-quality coaching and a love for the game, our goal is to help each athlete build confidence, develop their skills, and leave camp better both on and off the field."

results.name: Nike Soccer Camp with Next Step Training - Norfolk -  (Dec. 28ΓÇô30, 2026)
results.description: Next Step Training was voted a top 10 Nike Soccer Camp in 2025 by players and parents! Next Step's soccer camps provide exceptional coaching and a welcoming atmosphere that helps players of all levels grow. With engaging drills, supportive instructors, and a strong emphasis on teamwork, it creates an exciting environment where kids can build confidence, improve their skills, and have a great time on the field. Join us for an amazing camp session at the Nike Soccer Camp with Next Step Training in Norfolk, MA. Team up with Camp Director Nicholas Woodruff for the ultimate soccer training camp! Next Step Training was founded in order to provide a unique competitive experience for the BEST local kids in and around the Southeastern Massachusetts/Rhode Island area. The combination of high-level coaching, invite-only environments, and a true club-neutral philosophy makes Next Step one of the most elite supplemental training experiences in New England. The overall goal of each training session is to provide technical, tactical, and mental growth while encouraging players to be creative to help them become the most complete version of themselves. "At Next Step Soccer, our camps are built around one simple idea, develop the player, not just the session. Every activity is designed to improve how players think, move, and make decisions in the game, while building confidence and a genuine love for soccer. We create a high-energy, supportive environment where players are challenged, coached with purpose, and leave each day better than they arrived, both on and off the field." - Nick Woodruff, Camp Director & Founder, Next Step Training
